title: config looks_like_bcrypt_hash rejects $2x$ that store accepts
description: crates/reader/src/config.rs looks_like_bcrypt_hash() only accepts $2b$, $2a$, $2y$ prefixes, but parse_bcrypt_cost() in both credential stores also accepts $2x$. An operator who generates a $2x$ hash would get a spurious Config::validate() error at startup even though the hash is cryptographically valid and would verify correctly. The two validation layers are inconsistent: config rejects $2x$ at startup; store accepts it. Fix: align looks_like_bcrypt_hash to also accept $2x$ (matching the store), or drop $2x$ from parse_bcrypt_cost (matching config).
